note: Stratified verification sample, chosen BEFORE reading pass-1 results (written while pass-1 extraction was still running in the background). Pre-registering the sample before seeing the agent's answers is the point: picking the sample after seeing results would let the sample quietly favor apps the agent got right.
selection_rule: At least one app per category. Within that, deliberately weighted toward apps expected to be hard (partner-gated fintech, data-broker/enterprise research tools, apps with dead/JS-only docs) plus a few well-known apps as an easy-case control group, so the accuracy number isn't just measuring the easy half of the set.
